title: Jujutsu Kaisen Drops New Look At The Strongest Sorcerers Ahead of Its Biggest Event
content: Even two years after the main story’s conclusion, Jujutsu Kaisen remains one of the hottest Shonen Jump series. Part of the reason why the fan base is so active is that the franchise keeps returning with new updates and releases. This also includes the anime series since it has yet to fully adapt the story.
author: ComicBook

title: Solo Leveling Returns With a New Story Ahead of New Movie
content: The wait for Solo Leveling Season 3 is longer than ever as the animation studio remains silent on the highly anticipated sequel. The second season of the anime reached its conclusion last year, but the anime hasn’t been officially renewed for a third season.
author: ComicBook

title: Akumi Agitogi's The Emperor's Shaman Novels Get New Manga Adaptation
content: This year's 17th issue of Hakusensha 's Hana to Yume magazine announced on Wednesday that Akumi Agitogi 's The Emperor's Shaman ( Kyūtei no Majinaishi ) novels are getting a new manga series adaptation, which will launch on The Hana to Yume + manga website on August 10.
author: ANN

title: Atari Katagiri, Makoto Kisaragi Launch New Romantic Drama Manga
content: Manga creators Atari Katagiri and Makoto Kisaragi launched the Watashi-tachi no Koto wa Nanto Yobeba (What Should We Call Our Relationship?) manga on Square Enix 's Manga UP! service on Sunday. Katagiri is drawing the art and penning the story, and Kisaragi is in charge of composition.
